content_html:
Your photos, backed up to your own Telegram.
Every photo and video, in original quality and end-to-end encrypted, in a private channel you own.
One fast timeline on iPhone, Mac and Android.

Website · Download · Features · FAQ · Changelog · Telegram group · Support

Why Lelvo

Every photo cloud makes the same deal: free at first, then a monthly plan, run by a company that can see your library. Telegram already gives every account cloud storage with no stated cap. Lelvo turns it into a real photo backup that you own: a private channel in your own Telegram account, locked with a passphrase only you know.

No Lelvo servers, no Lelvo account, no analytics and no ads. Your photos go from your device to your Telegram library and nowhere else.

Lelvo iCloud Photos Google Photos
Free storage Your Telegram account's cloud, no stated cap 5 GB 15 GB, shared with Gmail and Drive
After that Still free Monthly plan Monthly plan
Original files, bit for bit Yes Yes Yes (Original quality uses your storage)
End-to-end encryption Always on Only with Advanced Data Protection No
Open source Yes, every line No No
Leave any time Export everything, or decrypt with the open format Yes Yes (Takeout)

Note

Lelvo uses the Telegram API. It is an independent app, not made, endorsed or supported by Telegram. Your storage lives in your Telegram account and follows Telegram's Terms of Service.

Download

Platform Get it Requirements
Mac Download Lelvo.dmg, open it and drag Lelvo to Applications macOS 15 or later, Apple silicon or Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
Android Download the .apk from the latest release and open it on your phone Android 10 or later (arm64)
iPhone beta Join the TestFlight beta, or sideload the IPA iOS 17 or later. App Store release in preparation.

One library works on all three: a photo backed up on one device shows on the others.

Installing the APK on Android
  1. Download Lelvo-<version>.apk from the latest release on your phone.
  2. Open the file. If Android asks, allow your browser or Files app to install unknown apps.
  3. Tap Install. Later updates install over the existing app and keep your sign-in.
Sideloading on iPhone
  1. Download Lelvo.ipa from the latest release. It's unsigned; your sideloading tool signs it with your Apple ID.
  2. SideStore: My Apps → + → pick the IPA. It refreshes on the device every few days. AltStore: My Apps → +. AltServer on your computer refreshes it over Wi-Fi. Sideloadly: drag the IPA in, enter your Apple ID, then Start.
  3. On first launch: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → trust your Apple ID. Turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode if iOS asks.

Apps signed with a free Apple ID stop opening after 7 days unless refreshed. If that happens, install the IPA again over the old one: your sign-in and data stay.

Opening a Mac app you built yourself

Release builds are notarized and open like any other app. Builds from source are not, so macOS says it "can't check the app for malicious software". Click Done, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway next to Lelvo, then Open. You only do this once.

Features

  • Original files. HEIC, ProRAW, RAW + JPEG, HEVC, ProRes, 4K, HDR and Dolby Vision are uploaded bit for bit, with EXIF, location, edits and Live Photos intact.
  • End-to-end encrypted. Every file and its details are locked on your device before upload. Telegram only ever stores files it can't open.
  • One timeline. Photos on your device and in your Telegram library together, by day, month or year, with Collections, Memories, albums, favorites, a map and on-device search.
  • Fast from the cloud. Videos get a small 1080p copy made on your device, so they start in under a second. Switch to the 4K original at any time. Saving or sharing always gives you the original file.
  • Automatic backup. New photos back up in the background on iPhone, Mac and Android.
  • Restore by signing in. On a new phone, sign in and your library comes back: dates, places, albums, favorites and Live Photos.
  • Never twice. Items are matched by fingerprint, so nothing uploads twice across reinstalls or devices.
  • Verified before it counts. An item is backed up only after Telegram confirms every part with the expected size.
  • Free up space safely. Only items checked complete in Telegram are offered, and the system asks you to confirm before anything leaves your device.
  • Big files work. Up to 2 GB per file (4 GB with Telegram Premium). Larger files are split and joined for you.
  • Recently Deleted. Items you delete from your backup stay recoverable for 30 days on all your devices.
  • Import from Google Photos. Bring in Google Takeout zips with dates, places, albums and favorites.
  • Keep a second copy. Download your whole library to Files, a drive or a Mac folder, and keep it up to date.
  • Native on every platform. SwiftUI on iPhone and Mac, Jetpack Compose on Android.

How it works

  1. You sign in with your own Telegram account. Lelvo creates a private channel there: your library.
  2. Each photo is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM, using a key made from your passphrase (PBKDF2, 600,000 rounds). Its date, name and size are encrypted too.
  3. Lelvo uploads it to your channel, at most two files at a time, and waits whenever Telegram asks it to slow down.
  4. Any of your devices can open the library with your passphrase or recovery key.

Open the channel in the normal Telegram app and you only see unreadable .cge files. Telegram can't open them, and neither can we. The channel is the source of truth, and its storage format is public, so your photos stay yours even without Lelvo. More in ARCHITECTURE.md.

Getting started

  1. Tap Continue with Telegram and enter your Telegram phone number.
  2. Enter the code Telegram sends to your other Telegram apps, and your two-step password if you use one.
  3. New here? Create a library, choose a passphrase and keep the recovery key somewhere safe. Coming back? Lelvo finds your library and restores it.
  4. Allow Full Access to Photos, then tap Backup → Back up now. For a big first backup, keep the app open on Wi-Fi and power.

Before you trust it with your only copy

Your backup lives in a Telegram account that Telegram controls. Read these once:

  1. Telegram deletes inactive accounts, and the channel goes with them. Lelvo shows the setting and can raise it to 2 years in Settings → Telegram. Open the Telegram app now and then.
  2. Deleting the channel deletes the backup, and it can't be restored. Don't delete or edit its messages by hand.
  3. Losing both your passphrase and recovery key means losing the photos. Nobody can recover them, including us.
  4. Keep a second copy of what you can't replace. Settings → Download a copy of your library makes that easy.

Details, with links to Telegram's own pages, are in the FAQ.

Limitations

  • No shared albums, links or family libraries. It's a private backup of your own photos.
  • No face or object search. Nothing analyses your photos, on a server or otherwise.
  • No Windows, Linux or web app is planned (why). The open format lets anyone build compatible tools.
  • On iPhone, a big first backup needs the app open, or iOS 26's background continuation.
  • Cloud speed is Telegram's. Free accounts get about 1 MB/s, so a 4K original takes a while to save.
  • Telegram's limits and terms apply to your storage, and Lelvo can't change them.

FAQ

Is this allowed by Telegram?

Yes. Telegram opens its API to third-party apps under the Telegram API Terms of Service, and Lelvo follows them: its own app key, no "Telegram" in its name, no Telegram logo, and it only acts on your own library channel.

Can Telegram see my photos?

No. Every file and caption is encrypted on your device before upload. Telegram cloud chats on their own aren't end-to-end encrypted (Telegram FAQ), which is why Lelvo locks every file first.

Is the storage really unlimited?

Telegram describes its cloud storage as unlimited, with files up to 2 GB each, or 4 GB with Premium (Terms of Service, FAQ). That's Telegram's offer, not a promise Lelvo can make, and it can change.

Will it fill up my phone?

No. Thumbnails and viewed items are cached with limits (300 MB and 1 GB by default) that you can change or clear in Settings → Storage.

More answers in the FAQ. Still stuck? Ask in the Telegram group or GitHub Discussions, or see SUPPORT.md.

Privacy

Lelvo has no servers and never receives your data: no analytics, crash reporting or tracking. Your phone number and login code go only to Telegram. Your session and encryption key stay in your device's Keychain or Keystore. Logs stay on your device unless you share them, with phone numbers, keys and IDs removed first. Full policy: PRIVACY.md.

Contributing

Bug reports, ideas, translations and code are welcome. Read CONTRIBUTING.md first.

  • Bugs and ideas start as issues, using the forms.
  • Code: wait for the issue to be labelled approved, then open a pull request that says Closes #<number>. Docs-only changes don't need an issue.
  • First-time contributors sign the Contributor License Agreement; a bot asks on your first pull request.
  • Please follow the Code of Conduct. Report security problems privately: SECURITY.md.

Building from source

iPhone and Mac: Xcode 26 or later and XcodeGen.

brew install xcodegen
git clone https://github.com/shahil-kv/Lelvo.git && cd Lelvo
xcodegen generate && open Lelvo.xcodeproj

Android: Android Studio and JDK 17. Put sdk.dir (and optionally telegram.apiId and telegram.apiHash) in android/local.properties, then:

cd android && ./gradlew :core:test :app:assembleDebug

Builds without app keys ask for a free Telegram api_id and api_hash on first launch. App keys, tests, the device workflow and releasing are covered in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

iOS/                 iPhone and iPad app
macOS/               Mac app
Shared/              Telegram, backup and screens shared by iPhone and Mac
Packages/LelvoCore/  storage format, encryption, index and upload queue, with unit tests
android/             Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose)
docs/                FAQ, architecture, storage format, changelog, development and release guides

Support

Lelvo is free and open source, and every feature stays free. Building it still costs money: Apple's $99 a year, test devices, the website and a lot of evenings. If Lelvo saves you a storage plan, a small contribution keeps it going.

Starring the repository also helps more people find it.

License

Lelvo is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. You may use, study, share and change it; copies you distribute stay under the same license, with their source code. The Lelvo name and icon are covered by TRADEMARKS.md. Third-party licenses are in NOTICE.md.

content_html_zh:
Your photos, backed up to your own Telegram. Every photo and video, in original quality and end-to-end encrypted, in a private channel you own. One fast timeline on iPhone, Mac and Android.

Website · Download · Features · FAQ · Changelog · Telegram group · Support

Why Lelvo

Every photo cloud makes the same deal: free at first, then a monthly plan, run by a company that can see your library. Telegram already gives every account cloud storage with no stated cap. Lelvo turns it into a real photo backup that you own: a private channel in your own Telegram account, locked with a passphrase only you know.

No Lelvo servers, no Lelvo account, no analytics and no ads. Your photos go from your device to your Telegram library and nowhere else.

Lelvo iCloud Photos Google Photos
Free storage Your Telegram account's cloud, no stated cap 5 GB 15 GB, shared with Gmail and Drive
After that Still free Monthly plan Monthly plan
Original files, bit for bit Yes Yes Yes (Original quality uses your storage)
End-to-end encryption 始终开启 Only with Advanced Data Protection No
开源 Yes, every line No No
Leave any time Export everything, or decrypt with the open format Yes Yes (Takeout)

Note

Lelvo uses the Telegram API. It is an independent app, not made, endorsed or supported by Telegram. Your storage lives in your Telegram account and follows Telegram's Terms of Service.

下载

平台 Get it 要求
Mac Download Lelvo.dmg, open it and drag Lelvo to Applications macOS 15 or later, Apple silicon or Intel. 由 Apple 签署并公证。
安卓 Download the .apk from the latest release and open it on your phone Android 10 or later (arm64)
iPhone beta Join the TestFlight beta, or sideload the IPA iOS 17 or later. App Store release in preparation.

One library works on all three: a photo backed up on one device shows on the others.

Installing the APK on Android
  1. Download Lelvo-<version>.apk from the latest release on your phone.
  2. Open the file. If Android asks, allow your browser or Files app to install unknown apps.
  3. Tap Install. Later updates install over the existing app and keep your sign-in.
Sideloading on iPhone
  1. Download Lelvo.ipa from the latest release. It's unsigned; your sideloading tool signs it with your Apple ID.
  2. SideStore: My Apps → + → pick the IPA. It refreshes on the device every few days. AltStore: My Apps → +. AltServer on your computer refreshes it over Wi-Fi. Sideloadly: drag the IPA in, enter your Apple ID, then Start.
  3. On first launch: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → trust your Apple ID. Turn on Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode if iOS asks.

Apps signed with a free Apple ID stop opening after 7 days unless refreshed. If that happens, install the IPA again over the old one: your sign-in and data stay.

Opening a Mac app you built yourself

Release builds are notarized and open like any other app. Builds from source are not, so macOS says it "can't check the app for malicious software". Click Done, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway next to Lelvo, then Open. 您只需执行一次此操作。

特征

  • Original files. HEIC, ProRAW, RAW + JPEG, HEVC, ProRes, 4K, HDR and Dolby Vision are uploaded bit for bit, with EXIF, location, edits and Live Photos intact.
  • End-to-end encrypted. Every file and its details are locked on your device before upload. Telegram only ever stores files it can't open.
  • One timeline. Photos on your device and in your Telegram library together, by day, month or year, with Collections, Memories, albums, favorites, a map and on-device search.
  • Fast from the cloud. Videos get a small 1080p copy made on your device, so they start in under a second. Switch to the 4K original at any time. Saving or sharing always gives you the original file.
  • Automatic backup. New photos back up in the background on iPhone, Mac and Android.
  • Restore by signing in. On a new phone, sign in and your library comes back: dates, places, albums, favorites and Live Photos.
  • Never twice. Items are matched by fingerprint, so nothing uploads twice across reinstalls or devices.
  • Verified before it counts. An item is backed up only after Telegram confirms every part with the expected size.
  • Free up space safely. Only items checked complete in Telegram are offered, and the system asks you to confirm before anything leaves your device.
  • Big files work. Up to 2 GB per file (4 GB with Telegram Premium). Larger files are split and joined for you.
  • Recently Deleted. Items you delete from your backup stay recoverable for 30 days on all your devices.
  • Import from Google Photos. Bring in Google Takeout zips with dates, places, albums and favorites.
  • Keep a second copy. Download your whole library to Files, a drive or a Mac folder, and keep it up to date.
  • Native on every platform. SwiftUI on iPhone and Mac, Jetpack Compose on Android.

它是如何运作的

  1. You sign in with your own Telegram account. Lelvo creates a private channel there: your library.
  2. Each photo is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM, using a key made from your passphrase (PBKDF2, 600,000 rounds). Its date, name and size are encrypted too.
  3. Lelvo uploads it to your channel, at most two files at a time, and waits whenever Telegram asks it to slow down.
  4. Any of your devices can open the library with your passphrase or recovery key.

Open the channel in the normal Telegram app and you only see unreadable .cge files. Telegram can't open them, and neither can we. The channel is the source of truth, and its storage format is public, so your photos stay yours even without Lelvo. More in ARCHITECTURE.md.

入门

  1. Tap Continue with Telegram and enter your Telegram phone number.
  2. Enter the code Telegram sends to your other Telegram apps, and your two-step password if you use one.
  3. 新来的？ Create a library, choose a passphrase and keep the recovery key somewhere safe. Coming back? Lelvo finds your library and restores it.
  4. Allow Full Access to Photos, then tap Backup → Back up now. For a big first backup, keep the app open on Wi-Fi and power.

Before you trust it with your only copy

Your backup lives in a Telegram account that Telegram controls. Read these once:

  1. Telegram deletes inactive accounts, and the channel goes with them. Lelvo shows the setting and can raise it to 2 years in Settings → Telegram. Open the Telegram app now and then.
  2. Deleting the channel deletes the backup, and it can't be restored. Don't delete or edit its messages by hand.
  3. Losing both your passphrase and recovery key means losing the photos. Nobody can recover them, including us.
  4. Keep a second copy of what you can't replace. Settings → Download a copy of your library makes that easy.

Details, with links to Telegram's own pages, are in the FAQ.

局限性

  • No shared albums, links or family libraries. It's a private backup of your own photos.
  • No face or object search. Nothing analyses your photos, on a server or otherwise.
  • No Windows, Linux or web app is planned (why). The open format lets anyone build compatible tools.
  • On iPhone, a big first backup needs the app open, or iOS 26's background continuation.
  • Cloud speed is Telegram's. Free accounts get about 1 MB/s, so a 4K original takes a while to save.
  • Telegram's limits and terms apply to your storage, and Lelvo can't change them.

FAQ

Is this allowed by Telegram?

是的。 Telegram opens its API to third-party apps under the Telegram API Terms of Service, and Lelvo follows them: its own app key, no "Telegram" in its name, no Telegram logo, and it only acts on your own library channel.

Can Telegram see my photos?

No. Every file and caption is encrypted on your device before upload. Telegram cloud chats on their own aren't end-to-end encrypted (Telegram FAQ), which is why Lelvo locks every file first.

Is the storage really unlimited?

Telegram describes its cloud storage as unlimited, with files up to 2 GB each, or 4 GB with Premium (Terms of Service, FAQ). That's Telegram's offer, not a promise Lelvo can make, and it can change.

Will it fill up my phone?

No. Thumbnails and viewed items are cached with limits (300 MB and 1 GB by default) that you can change or clear in Settings → Storage.

More answers in the FAQ. 还卡住了吗？ Ask in the Telegram group or GitHub Discussions, or see SUPPORT.md.

隐私

Lelvo has no servers and never receives your data: no analytics, crash reporting or tracking. Your phone number and login code go only to Telegram. Your session and encryption key stay in your device's Keychain or Keystore. Logs stay on your device unless you share them, with phone numbers, keys and IDs removed first. Full policy: PRIVACY.md.

贡献

Bug reports, ideas, translations and code are welcome. 首先阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md。

  • Bugs and ideas start as issues, using the forms.
  • Code: wait for the issue to be labelled approved, then open a pull request that says Closes #<number>. Docs-only changes don't need an issue.
  • First-time contributors sign the Contributor License Agreement; a bot asks on your first pull request.
  • Please follow the Code of Conduct. Report security problems privately: SECURITY.md.

从源头构建

iPhone and Mac: Xcode 26 or later and XcodeGen.

brew install xcodegen
git clone https://github.com/shahil-kv/Lelvo.git && cd Lelvo
xcodegen generate && open Lelvo.xcodeproj

Android: Android Studio and JDK 17. Put sdk.dir (and optionally telegram.apiId and telegram.apiHash) in android/local.properties, then:

cd android && ./gradlew :core:test :app:assembleDebug

Builds without app keys ask for a free Telegram api_id and api_hash on first launch. App keys, tests, the device workflow and releasing are covered in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

iOS/                 iPhone and iPad app
macOS/               Mac app
Shared/              Telegram, backup and screens shared by iPhone and Mac
Packages/LelvoCore/  storage format, encryption, index and upload queue, with unit tests
android/             Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose)
docs/                FAQ, architecture, storage format, changelog, development and release guides

支持

Lelvo is free and open source, and every feature stays free. Building it still costs money: Apple's $99 a year, test devices, the website and a lot of evenings. If Lelvo saves you a storage plan, a small contribution keeps it going.

Starring the repository also helps more people find it.
